desc: Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) integration for security response and investigation. Manage Cloud Firewall access-control policies (block/allow/monitor traffic) and address books, audit existing policies and address books, and investigate Security Center alarm (alert) events. Authentication is via an AccessKey pair with request signing handled by the official Alibaba Cloud SDK.

functions.label: Add Control Policy
functions.name: add_control_policy
functions.desc: Create a Cloud Firewall access-control policy to block, allow, or monitor traffic.

inParameters.label: ACL Action
inParameters.name: acl_action
inParameters.desc: Action for matching traffic: accept, drop, or log

inParameters.label: Direction
inParameters.name: direction
inParameters.desc: Traffic direction: in or out

inParameters.label: Source
inParameters.name: source
inParameters.desc: Source address (e.g., CIDR, address book name, or domain depending on source type)

inParameters.label: Source Type
inParameters.name: source_type
inParameters.desc: Type of the source: net, group, or location

inParameters.label: Destination
inParameters.name: destination
inParameters.desc: Destination address (CIDR, domain, address book name, etc.)

inParameters.label: Destination Type
inParameters.name: destination_type
inParameters.desc: Type of the destination: net, group, domain, or location

inParameters.label: Protocol
inParameters.name: proto
inParameters.desc: Protocol: ANY, TCP, UDP, or ICMP

inParameters.label: Description
inParameters.name: description
inParameters.desc: Description of the policy

inParameters.label: New Order
inParameters.name: new_order
inParameters.desc: Priority order of the policy (-1 places it last)

inParameters.label: Application Name
inParameters.name: application_name
inParameters.desc: Application name the policy applies to (e.g., ANY, HTTP, HTTPS)

inParameters.label: Destination Port
inParameters.name: dest_port
inParameters.desc: Destination port or port range

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Created policy details, including the ACL UUID
